story.title: Temple Arrival
story.text: You are guiding Alex through the first courtyard of the temple. Visitors are quietly admiring the architecture while signs explain the house rules.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: This temple looks amazing. Can I take photos here?

choices.text: Yes, you can in permitted areas and without disturbing others.

feedback.reaction: Alex smiles 😊 and carefully lifts the camera.
Alex looks confused 😕 and lowers the camera.

choices.text: Only if you run to the front quickly.

feedback.reaction: Alex hesitates 😬 because that sounds disrespectful.

story.title: At the Prayer Hall
story.text: Alex reaches the entrance of the main hall, where the atmosphere becomes more formal and respectful. Temple etiquette matters more here.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Do I need to remove my shoes before entering the hall?

choices.text: Yes, please remove them before you step inside.

feedback.reaction: Alex nods 🙌 and leaves the shoes neatly outside.

choices.text: No, shoes are always fine indoors.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks uncertain 😕 because the sign says otherwise.

choices.text: Only tourists have to do that, not locals.

feedback.reaction: Alex frowns 😒 at the unfair advice.

story.title: Inside the Gallery
story.text: The mural gallery is peaceful, and visitors are moving slowly to take in the details. Your role is to help Alex match the tone of the space.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: This room is beautiful. Can I speak loudly so my friends hear me?

choices.text: Please keep your voice low because this is a quiet area.

feedback.reaction: Alex whispers 🙂 and takes in the artwork peacefully.

choices.text: Sure, shout as loud as you want.

feedback.reaction: Alex winces 😬 when nearby visitors stare back.

choices.text: Only if you sing instead of speaking.

feedback.reaction: Alex laughs awkwardly 😅 but still has no clear answer.

story.title: Offering Time
story.text: The courtyard is busy with people making offerings. Alex wants to join respectfully, but needs your help to understand the expected behavior.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: I want to make an offering. What should I do first?

choices.text: Stand calmly, follow the local queue, and copy the posted instructions.

feedback.reaction: Alex smiles 😊 and joins the line respectfully.

choices.text: Push to the front so you get the best spot.

feedback.reaction: Alex looks embarrassed 😳 by the rude suggestion.

choices.text: Skip the signs because they are probably not important.

feedback.reaction: Alex pauses 😕 and decides that sounds risky.

story.title: Journey End
story.text: Alex is ready to leave the temple garden. One final social moment remains, and a polite closing will complete the stage cleanly.

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.text: Thank you for guiding me. How do I thank the staff politely?

choices.text: Say thank you politely and give a respectful smile.

feedback.reaction: Alex beams 😄 and offers a warm, respectful thank you.
Alex looks uneasy 😕 because that feels impolite.

choices.text: Complain loudly about the heat before leaving.

feedback.reaction: Alex grimaces 😒 because that would ruin the moment.
